existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: No fee shall be charged for the first two (2) hours of labor in responding to a resident's public records request.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: no fee shall be charged for the first two (2) hours of labor in responding to a request submitted by a resident for public records, or for copying the first one hundred (100) pages
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Resident-only free allotment. Split from the free-copies allotment (ID-0018) which shares the same source sentence.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: No fee shall be charged for copying the first one hundred (100) pages of paper records in responding to a resident's request.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: no fee shall be charged for the first two (2) hours of labor in responding to a request submitted by a resident for public records, or for copying the first one hundred (100) pages
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Resident-only free allotment; charges above the threshold governed by the actual-cost ceiling (ID-0019).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Copy fee may not exceed actual cost (resident)
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The fee charged to a resident may not exceed the actual cost to the agency of copying the record.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Copies provided beyond the free allotment
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The fee for residents may not exceed the actual cost to the agency of copying the record
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Idaho sets no statutory per-page cents rate; the ceiling is 'actual cost' (city supplies the operative rate under it).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Labor charges limited to reasonable cost at lowest-paid staff rate
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Fees for resident requests shall not exceed reasonable labor costs necessarily incurred, charged at the per-hour pay rate of the lowest-paid administrative staff employee or public official of the agency.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Labor incurred beyond the free 2-hour allotment
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Fees for requests made by residents shall not exceed reasonable labor costs necessarily incurred in responding to a public records request ... shall be charged at the per hour pay rate of the lowest paid administrative staff employee or public official of the public agency
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Two verbatim fragments from 74-102(10)(e) joined; the labor rate is bound to a specific staff pay rate (city supplies the actual dollar rate under the ceiling).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Computer/electronic record fee capped at sum of enumerated costs
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For computer records, the agency may charge a fee that does not exceed the sum of the direct cost of copying, the standard cost of publication, and the cost of conversion.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Request for records maintained in a computer/electronic system
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: a public agency or public official may charge a fee...that does not exceed the sum of [direct cost of copying, standard cost of publication, and cost of conversion]
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Verbatim lead clause captured with ellipsis; the three enumerated cost components should be re-captured verbatim from 74-102(10)(d) for the exact list.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Nonresident fees may be higher but not exceed actual cost
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The agency may charge nonresidents higher fees than residents (including for labor and copies without the resident free allotments), but such fees may not exceed the actual cost to the agency.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Agencies may charge higher fees for non-residents, though fees cannot exceed actual costs (paraphrased from 74-102)
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Paraphrase flagged: retrieved text summarized the nonresident fee treatment; needs verbatim re-capture of the exact 74-102(10) nonresident subsection. Core fork: nonresidents do not receive the resident free-labor/free-copy allotments.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Fee waiver in the public interest for indigent resident requester
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The agency shall not charge a resident any cost or fee for copies or labor when the examination is likely to contribute significantly to public understanding, is not primarily in the individual interest of the requester, and the requester lacks sufficient financial resources such that fees would prevent access.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Resident requester meets the public-interest and inability-to-pay conditions
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The public agency shall not charge any cost or fee for copies or labor when the requester is a resident [and the examination is likely to contribute to public understanding, is not primarily in the individual interest, and fees would prevent access due to insufficient resources]
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Verbatim lead clause captured; the three-part waiver test in brackets was summarized and should be re-captured verbatim. Waiver limited to residents. Multi-factor conjunctive standard kept in one row per grain rule.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Custodian may require advance payment of fees
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The custodian may require advance payment of the fees authorized by this section before providing the records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Fees are authorized for the request
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The custodian may require advance payment of fees authorized by this section
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Discretionary ('may'); permits an advance-payment/deposit gate on production.
